_doc: Seed recipe DB: Lakshith's 20 dishes, one serving each, adapted to a kadai + saucepan on induction (no blender, microwave, pressure cooker or oven). Tiers are cumulative. Slot syntax: 'id' or 'id:qty' (qty in the ingredient's unit), 'a|b' = a or substitute b, leading '?' = optional (never blocks a tier). 'needs' lists equipment a tier requires. 'art' drives the illustrated plate until you add your own photo.

tiers.name: Basic
steps: Use leftover rice, or boil 80 g rice in the saucepan for 12 min and spread to cool
Scramble the eggs in a hot kadai and set aside
Toss the rice with soy sauce on high heat, fold the eggs back in

tiers.name: Chilli garlic
steps: Fry the onion with a spoon of ginger-garlic paste and chilli flakes before the rice
Finish with a drizzle of chilli oil

tiers.name: Loaded
steps: Stir-fry diced carrot, peas and capsicum on high heat before the rice
Crack black pepper over the top

tiers.name: Basic
steps: Temper mustard seeds in oil in the saucepan
Fry onion, add chopped tomatoes and spices, cook to a thick masala
Add washed rice and 1.75× water, cover and cook on low for 15 min

tiers.name: Masala
steps: Add ginger-garlic paste and green chilli with the onion
Stir in peas and garam masala before the rice

tiers.name: With raita
steps: Fry peanuts in ghee and spoon over the rice
Whisk curd with salt and a pinch of roasted jeera for raita

tiers.name: Basic
steps: Dice the potatoes small and parboil in salted water for 7 min, then drain well
Fry in a thin layer of oil in the kadai, turning only when golden

tiers.name: Peri-peri
steps: Add onion once the potatoes crisp
Toss with peri-peri mix off the heat

tiers.name: Loaded
steps: Add capsicum with the onion
Fry an egg and slide it on top; tear a cheese slice over the hot hash

tiers.name: Basic
steps: Cook the frozen momos as the packet says, without thawing
Pan-fry in a little oil until the bottoms crisp

tiers.name: With dip
steps: Mix soy sauce, sriracha, chilli oil and a splash of water as a dip

tiers.name: Chilli tossed
steps: Stir-fry onion, capsicum and ginger-garlic paste on high heat
Add the sauce, then toss the crisp momos through it

tiers.name: Fork-mashed
steps: Mash the banana to a smooth paste with a fork
Whisk in the peanut butter and honey, then the cold milk a little at a time

tiers.name: Muesli bowl
steps: Pour the shake over muesli in a bowl, top with curd and a pinch of cinnamon

tiers.name: Blended protein
steps: Blend everything with a scoop of protein powder until smooth

tiers.name: Veg pulao
steps: Fry a bay leaf and jeera in ghee in the saucepan
Sauté onion until golden, add peas
Add washed rice and 1.75× water with salt, cover and cook on low for 15 min

tiers.name: Paneer
steps: Add two cardamom pods with the bay leaf, and diced carrot with the peas
Pan-fry paneer cubes in the kadai and fold them in with garam masala; rest covered 5 min

tiers.name: With raita
steps: Add a spoon of ginger-garlic paste after the onion
Serve with curd whisked with salt and black pepper

tiers.name: Quick masala
steps: Chop onion and tomato very fine (no blender needed)
Cook in the kadai until completely soft, mashing with the back of the ladle
Add paneer and a splash of water, simmer 5 min

tiers.name: Butter masala
steps: Start the masala in butter with ginger-garlic paste
Crush kasuri methi over the top with a last knob of butter

tiers.name: Restaurant
steps: Stir in milk or cream and a few drops of honey for that restaurant sweetness
Serve over rice cooked in the saucepan

tiers.name: Basic
steps: Boil soya chunks for 6 min, drain and squeeze dry
Fry onion until golden, add tomato and spices, cook to a thick gravy
Add soya and a little water, simmer 10 min

tiers.name: Masala
steps: Add ginger-garlic paste after the onion, then coriander powder and garam masala

tiers.name: Full meal
steps: Toss the squeezed soya in curd and spices for 10 min before cooking
Finish with kasuri methi and serve with rice

tiers.name: Basic
steps: Simmer washed moong dal with turmeric and 3× water in the saucepan for 20 min (moong needs no cooker)
Cook rice alongside

tiers.name: Tadka
steps: Crackle jeera and mustard in ghee, take off the heat, add chilli powder and pour over the dal

tiers.name: Dhaba
steps: Build the tadka with onion, ginger-garlic paste and tomato until jammy
Simmer the dal in it for 3 min, crush in kasuri methi

tiers.name: Basic
steps: Brown the onion in the kadai, add tomato and spices and cook until thick
Add chicken, coat well, cover and cook 20–25 min until it reaches 74°C inside

tiers.name: Masala
steps: Add ginger-garlic paste after the onion; garam masala at the end

tiers.name: Sunday
steps: Marinate the chicken in curd and spices for 15 min
Finish with kasuri methi, serve with rice

tiers.name: Quick toss
steps: Cube and pan-fry the paneer in the kadai until golden
Toss with soy sauce, chilli flakes and a splash of water

tiers.name: Dry
steps: Stir-fry onion petals and capsicum on high heat with ginger-garlic paste
Add sriracha with the soy, then the paneer

tiers.name: Gravy
steps: Thicken with a spoon of cornflour in water
Finish with chilli oil, serve over rice

tiers.name: Basic
steps: Cut chicken small, season with salt and pepper
Sear in a very hot kadai until cooked through, toss with ginger-garlic paste and soy

tiers.name: Chilli garlic
steps: Add onion and capsicum for the last 3 min, then sriracha

tiers.name: Bowl
steps: Glaze with chilli oil (and a cornflour slurry if you have it)
Serve over rice

tiers.name: Basic
steps: Boil the eggs 9 min in the saucepan, peel and slit
Make a thick onion-tomato masala in the kadai, add water to a gravy
Simmer the eggs in it for 5 min

tiers.name: Masala
steps: Fry the slit eggs briefly in oil with chilli powder first
Add ginger-garlic paste and the powders to the masala

tiers.name: Full meal
steps: Finish with kasuri methi, serve with rice

tiers.name: Basic
steps: Use leftover rice (or cook 80 g for 12 min and cool)
Warm puliyogare paste in oil for a minute, fold in the rice

tiers.name: Tempered
steps: Temper mustard seeds and green chilli before the paste

tiers.name: Temple-style
steps: Fry peanuts in ghee for crunch
Serve with a bowl of curd

tiers.name: Quick
steps: Mix curd with spices and salt, coat the paneer cubes
Sear in a hot kadai, turning until charred on several sides

tiers.name: Tandoori
steps: Add ginger-garlic paste, garam masala and crushed kasuri methi to the marinade

tiers.name: Skewer-style
steps: Marinate paneer with onion and capsicum chunks for 20 min
Sear everything together, finish with lemon juice

tiers.name: Basic
steps: Brown jeera and onion in the saucepan, add chicken and brown lightly
Add washed rice and 1.75× water, cover and cook on low 18 min; rest 10 min

tiers.name: Spiced
steps: Start with bay leaf and cardamom, add ginger-garlic paste with the chicken

tiers.name: Loaded
steps: Add peas and carrot with the rice, finish with ghee
Serve with curd

tiers.name: Basic
steps: Sear paneer cubes in butter and set aside
Melt cheese into the milk over low heat with pepper, return the paneer

tiers.name: Chilli
steps: Brown the onion before the milk; finish with chilli flakes

tiers.name: Loaded
steps: Add capsicum with the onion
Toast bread in the kadai to mop it up

tiers.name: Basic
steps: Beat the eggs with salt and pepper
Cook in a lightly oiled pan over medium-low heat and fold

tiers.name: Masala
steps: Beat chopped onion, green chilli and chilli flakes into the eggs

tiers.name: Cheesy toast
steps: Lay cheese on the omelette before folding and let it melt
Toast buttered bread in the same pan

tiers.name: Rustic
steps: Sauté onion in the saucepan, add diced potato and carrot with water to cover
Simmer 15 min until soft, then mash with a ladle or fork

tiers.name: Creamy
steps: Start the onion in butter
Loosen the mash with milk and warm through gently

tiers.name: Velvety
steps: Blend until silky
Serve with toast and chilli flakes

recipes.name: Spiced Veg Rice Bowl with Fried Egg

tiers.name: Basic
steps: Crackle jeera in oil, toss in cooked rice with garam masala and salt
Top with a fried egg

tiers.name: Veg
steps: Fry onion, diced carrot and peas until tender before the rice

tiers.name: Loaded
steps: Add capsicum with the veg; finish with chilli oil and cracked pepper
